# Vendored libraries

Kept in the repository so the tool and its tests need no network and no install step.

| File | Library | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `pdf-lib.min.js` | pdf-lib 1.17.1 (https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib) | MIT, see `pdf-lib.LICENSE.md` |
| `fontkit.umd.min.js` | @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 (https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit) | MIT (Andrew Dillon, Devon Govett) |

The fonts in `../fonts/` are Carlito (Regular and Bold), metric-compatible with Calibri, under the SIL Open Font Licence 1.1 (`../fonts/OFL.txt`).
